gallery.title: File:Elgin Cathedral from Newmill Road.jpg
gallery.description: The historic ruins of Elgin Cathedral, dating back to the 13th century, was once the seat of the Bishop of Moray. The photograph is taken from the south-west on Newmill Road, next to the Landshut bridge.
